mapper.select: SELECT batch_id AS batchId, MIN(created_at) AS batchAt, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 0 AND config_error = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN config_error = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS configErrors, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT scenario) = 1 THEN MIN(scenario) ELSE NULL END AS scenario FROM eval_result GROUP BY batch_id ORDER BY batchAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
